Mykonos

Whitewash, wind and a very long lunch.

The place

Cycladic white, a blue that looks edited, and a social calendar that runs late. Mykonos is the Aegean at its most polished — and, away from the crowds, still full of quiet corners.

The island works on two speeds. The town and the southern beaches are the Mykonos of the magazines; the north and the interior are older, quieter and, for many of our clients, the real reason to come. Our houses sit mostly on the western side, where the sunsets are.

We are new to Mykonos, and deliberately selective. Every house has been visited, every licence checked, and every owner met. The portfolio will grow slowly.

  • 01

    Agios Lazaros

    The view west, the sunsets and a short drive to the best beaches.

  • 02

    The town

    Little Venice, the windmills and a maze of lanes best walked without a plan.

  • 03

    The table

    Long Greek lunches, toes in the sand, nowhere else to be.

When to go

May — October

June and September are the sweet spot. July and August are for people who want the island at full volume.
